disclaimer: Model output under stated assumptions. Not a measurement of any Claude account, and not a prediction of the five-hour or weekly usage meter. Anthropic has not published meter weights. All usage is in cache-weighted units: input 1, 5-minute write 1.25, 1-hour write 2, cache read 0.05 on Opus 5.5 (0.1 and 0.025 as sensitivity), output 5.
caching: physical prefix: a warm call reads the previous prompt and writes previous output plus the new tail
trigger_formula: Claude Code v2.1.325 tle + WX: effective_window = window - min(maxOutputTokens, 20000); threshold = effective_window - 13000, or min(floor(effective_window * pct), effective_window - 13000)

scenarios.name: S2
warnings_lo: no_compaction: the session never reached the trigger

scenarios.name: S8
warnings_lo: compounding: an absolute window and CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE are both set. Claude Code v2.1.325 (tle + WX) applies the percentage to window - min(maxOutputTokens, 20000), so 250000 with 25 fires at floor(230000 x 0.25) = 57500. Check compactMetadata.preTokens.

scenarios.name: S8b
warnings_lo: compounding: an absolute window and CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE are both set. Claude Code v2.1.325 (tle + WX) applies the percentage to window - min(maxOutputTokens, 20000), so 250000 with 25 fires at floor(230000 x 0.25) = 57500. Check compactMetadata.preTokens.

zero_effect_control.note: Neither trigger fires. The setting does nothing.

eoq.formula: T* = R + sqrt(2 * K * (g + o) / r)
eoq.note: Triggers are fire points. Type 33,000 more with --autocompact. K equals the overhead simulate() charges per compaction, so the closed form and the trace agree. The live Opus 5.5 compactions averaged about 36.6k cache-weighted units against about 21.6k for the modeled summary call at a 107k fire, so the live-calibrated K is about 15k higher and the valley moves roughly 10k to the right. Optimum near 150k-200k is the 0.05x (Opus 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5) region.

use_cases.practice: One knob, firing near 120k. Sonnet 5 and Opus 4.7 read weights.
One knob, firing near 160k. This is the 150k-200k band.
Longer work with small steps wants a slightly earlier fire, near 130k.

use_cases.practice: Past the cache window, /clear and paste a short handoff unless history is under about 10k.

use_cases.workflow: Hourly claude -p cron with --resume vs fresh runs
use_cases.chart_label: Hourly claude -p with --resume, vs fresh runs
use_cases.penalty_vs: a fresh session every run, state kept in a file
use_cases.practice: Start every scheduled run fresh. Keep state in a file, not in --resume.

stale_resume_vs_clear.note: Stale resume pays only if carried history is under about 5k tokens per exploration call it saves. With no saved calls it always loses.

hot_resume_crossover.note: Hot resume wins only while carried history x remaining calls stays under about 120k token-calls at 0.05x reads (about 57k at 0.1x). The live -27.7% came from a tiny history (peak context 20,265).
